thread:
Alex Chen: FYI — ACME wants BYOK onboarding acceptance criteria + key rotation policy finalized for next sprint. Need a short checklist.
Mira Patel: can we list must-haves: successful TLS handshake, KM IP allowlist, audit log emit for every key operation, ability to rotate keys without downtime, proof key material never leaves customer env.
Samir Rao: agree. Also need a smoke test: create key, use to encrypt, rotate, decrypt previous ciphertext — must be automated.
Jordan Lee: map this to SOC2/ISO controls too. Legal will ask for retention windows for audit logs — ask customer for regulatory retention but we should propose baseline.
Lina Gomez: propose retention tiers: 90d searchable, 7y archived + hashed index. Ops runbook to export audit slices on request.
Alex Chen: @Mira can you draft the acceptance checklist? Samir you and I handle rotation smoke tests. Jordan capture SOC2 mapping?
Mira Patel: yes will draft. Quick Q: do we require KMS HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2) or just KMS API? Customer is finserv.
Samir Rao: finserv will need HSM-backed keys + attestation. Add HSM flag to acceptance.
deply-bot: (note: deploy-bot) keystore-integration-tests started on staging (run id 1123)
Lina Gomez: snippet for smoke test:
```bash
# create key
redwoodctl kms create-key --tenant acme --alias acme-key-1
# encrypt
redwoodctl kms encrypt --key acme-key-1 --data-file sample.txt
# rotate
redwoodctl kms rotate-key --key acme-key-1
# decrypt old ciphertext
redwoodctl kms decrypt --key acme-key-1 --ciphertext old.enc
```
Mira Patel: added rollback criteria: if rotation causes >5% error rate or p50 latency >200ms for 10m, rollback to previous key version and page oncall.
Jordan Lee: escalation: page sec-oncall, create incident ticket with evidence bundle (audit logs + config snapshot). Add legal notification for finserv customers.
Alex Chen: can we surface retention SLA? propose: indexing searchable logs 90d SLO, exportable archive 7y retention, export within 48h.
Samir Rao: timeline: basic acceptance draft by EOD Thu, smoke tests Wed, canary with 2 customers next week.
Mira Patel: I'll post checklist PR in #github after draft. tagging @Jordan Lee @Lina Gomez for review.
Jordan Lee: ack. also add 'customer-driven rollback opt-out' — customer can request immediate key untie if they want to stop using Redwood keystore.
Lina Gomez: noted. I'll add runbook steps for manual handback and evidence export.
Alex Chen: Action items: Mira checklist, Samir tests + runbook, Jordan SOC2 mapping, Lina export/runbook. Sync Thu 10am.
Samir Rao: :thumbsup: 
Mira Patel: :+1: 
Lina Gomez: :raised_hands:
